name: rules-fleet-regulations
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): Fleet Regulations (For) - 'each player cannot have more than 4 tokens in their fleet pool'. The original only posted a reminder after the 5th token was gained. With the law in play and Mahact's fleet pool at 3, the redistribute panel's first 'Gain 1 Fleet Token' is accepted and the second is refused (engine: CommandTokensAdjustKind.validate; bot: CommandCounterButtonHandler.increaseFleetCC; status homework: StatusTokensButtonHandler.check). The redistribute panel grants 0 tokens (cc-cap-all), so 2 tactic tokens are moved out first: fleet 3->4 is then a redistribution, and 4->5 is refused by Fleet Regulations.
